A prospective, open-label, phase 2 study to explore CAIX expression through 89Zirconium-labelled girentuximab deferoxamine (89Zr-girentuximab) PET/CT imaging in patients with solid tumors.

agents.drug_class_hint: zirconium-89-labelled anti-CAIX monoclonal antibody (girentuximab deferoxamine, TLX250) PET imaging agent

source_quote.quote: A prospective, open-label, phase 2 study to explore CAIX expression through 89Zirconium-labelled girentuximab deferoxamine (89Zr-girentuximab) PET/CT imaging in patients with solid tumors.

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study only: single administration of 89Zr-girentuximab for PET/CT; no therapeutic agent, so no candidate (S6 fail). Multi-tumour basket with GBM named in conditions and inclusion criteria. CAIX positivity is in the title but is not an entry requirement in the eligibility criteria; CAIX expression is the imaging endpoint and is recorded as exploratory_correlative 'other' (could arguably be excluded as an imaging-only marker). Treatment setting not stated.
